project.title: Shotgun metagenomic profiling of microbiomes and resistomes in the Espinar stabilization lagoons, Puno, Peru
project.description: This environmental shotgun metagenomics project characterizes bacterial community composition and antibiotic resistance gene profiles in the primary and secondary compartments of the Espinar stabilization lagoon system in Puno, Peru. Equal-volume water aliquots collected from four stations within each lagoon were pooled to generate one representative composite sample for each lagoon compartment. Microbial biomass was concentrated by filtration through 0.2-micrometer membrane filters, DNA was extracted, and paired-end libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000, generating reads of 151 bp. The study aims to determine how the microbiome and resistome differ along the two-stage municipal wastewater treatment train and to provide baseline data for environmental surveillance and future wastewater treatment research.
